nodes.title: Fraud case: Card C04274-K1 showed an undocumented pattern. Device profile 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' was used by 28 cards in a 60-day window, 28 behind an anonymous proxy. Four confirmed fraud cases were found, all involving this device profile and undocumented patterns. The transaction amount was $119.53, flagged as a new device. Final actions: BLOCK_CARD (L1), CREATE_CASE (auto), MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS (auto), FILE_REPORT (L2), ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST (auto).
